caption: The drawing features three distinct objects centered on a plain, off-white background. On the left is an elongated, vertically oriented decorative strip with a wavy outline, colored in light gray, and featuring small heart- and star-shaped cutouts, along with two red, star-like patterns. In the middle is an eight-pointed star, colored predominantly in red with alternating dark and light segments, and bordered by blue-gray accents on the points. On the right is another elongated decorative strip, also vertically oriented, with a rounded top, an undulating silhouette, and several small cutouts in the shapes of hearts, teardrops, and dots, similar in color to the left strip but with a simpler design. The signature “G. Quinta” appears in small text near the bottom right of the image.
title: Hair Ornaments
